8.content: - S: Starting position of the agent.

9.content: - F: Free or traversable cell; agent can move through it without termination.

10.content: - H: Hazardous cell; entering it terminates the episode negatively (observed indirectly via avoidance).

12.content: - Agent can move down and right through F cells successfully.

13.content: - G: Goal cell; entering it terminates the episode successfully with a positive reward (1).

14.content: - The environment is a fixed-size grid (7 rows x 7 columns) with boundaries that prevent movement outside the grid.
